blurb: Guests take boat charters with a captain and first mate to Cat Island, Ship Island, or on cruises through Bay St. Louis and the Mississippi Sound. Trips include anchoring near beaches and using a dinghy to reach the island. Special events can be customized with food, beverages, and extra crew.
extraNote: Valid credit card required to hold reservation · $20 non-refundable processing fee included in price · Cancellations 72+ hours prior: no charge except $20 fee · Cancellations 71-48 hours prior: charged 50% of charter amount · Cancellations less than 48 hours prior: charged full amount · Captain may delay, reschedule, or refund full amount for weather except food orders · Full refunds for cancellations due to boat or equipment issues · Customary 20% gratuity appreciated but not required
